ends.note: Faulkner (printed 'FAULKNER (ARMORY)') runs south from Flint and stops at the O.N.G. Armory grounds; an unlabelled 17 ft open strip along the armory's north wall runs west to Denman but is closed at x~1333 and is not drawn as a street

notes: North is up. Flint's north side is off the top edge; Flint centre taken 63 ft (about 110 px) north of the block line (y~353-364); the 4" water pipe runs at y~277, south of that centre. Flint stops at Freeman (block of sheet 79 closes it on the east). Florence (printed FLORENCE 50') enters from sheet 70 and ends at Denman (armory block east of Denman). Armory Av. is printed 'ARMORY AV. (EVERETT)'; it starts at Freeman. Dudley comes down from sheet 79 and ends at Armory Av. West of Freeman are the Academy Sisters of Mercy block and Lincoln Park, so all the cross streets and alleys east of Freeman (Clayers Al., Clinton, Wise Al., Betts, Laurel, Stephenson Al.) are T's on Freeman; Kenner (west side, centre y~2309) and Wise Alley (east side, centre y~2275) meet Freeman about 10 ft apart, recorded separately. The N-S 10 ft alley at x~2157 is Harold Alley: one label reading up the alley, 'HAROLD' south of the block-4 alley and 'ALLEY' north of it. The block-4 alley (15'6", unnamed) runs from that N-S alley east to Baymiller; it does not reach Freeman (closed by lots at x~1722). Kind at Baymiller checked against sheet 72: Clayers Al., the block-4 alley and Stephenson Al. stop at Baymiller; Armory, Clinton, Wise Al., Betts, Laurel and Hopkins continue. Baymiller's east side is off the right edge; centre taken 50 ft east of the lot line (x~3693-3707). Freeman centre drifts from x~1611 (top) to 1621 (Hopkins).
